objective: Run the moving-state dynamics M and the floor components F on the declared spaces and read S1-S3 and A26's verdict.
status: Supported in part 2026-11-10 (exploratory, pre-registered challenge of A26): a state flipping one point between learning steps without raising the dissonance freed the stuck learner in 23 of 50 one-atom runs and brought 28 of 50 two-atom runs to the floor (none with the state still); at the genus-2 floor the unit wanders only inside its own atom and that atom's junction faces (exhaustive on K_2). S1-S3 failed as stated. A26 Overturned as a limit on what learning reaches, by the frozen rule.
title: A moving state with learning on the atom spaces
